title: Welcome to Adopter Product A
description: A three-minute tour of the essentials. Skippable anytime.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.body: Adopter Product A helps you connect data and build notebooks. Three minutes to see the essentials.

steps.title: Your data lives here
steps.body: Connect a data source once; every notebook you build can read from it.

steps.title: Add your first data source
steps.body: Click here to connect a database or upload a file. Most first-time users start with a CSV.

steps.title: Pick a source type
steps.body: CSV, Postgres, BigQuery, or a REST endpoint. You can add more later.

steps.title: You are ready
steps.body: That is the essentials. Explore the checklist any time to walk the rest.
